args.command: $f = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Filter *.go; $lines = 0; foreach ($x in $f) { $c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($x.FullName); if ($c.Length -gt 0) { $lines += ([regex]::Matches($c, "`n")).Count; if (-not $c.EndsWith("`n")) { $lines += 1 } } }; [pscustomobject]@{files=$f.Count; lines=$lines} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

$f = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Filter *.go; $lines = 0; foreach ($x in $f) { $c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($x.FullName); if ($c.Length -eq 0) { continue }; $n = ([regex]::Matches($c, "`n")).Count; if (-not $c.EndsWith("`n")) { $n++ }; $lines += $n }; [pscustomobject]@{files=$f.Count; lines=$lines} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
